correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs every quantified branch: the cubic torus critical equations factor as \((a^2-b)(b-1)=0\) and \((a-1)(a-b^2)=0\), yielding exactly critical values \(0\) and \(\lambda^2=-27\); Hessian determinant \(-9\) gives nodes at the latter two values. Boundary charts give three fixed ordinary \(m\)-fold vertices and no other singularities. The two valuation vectors \((1,0)\) and \((0,1)\) force a Kummer extension of degree \(m^2\), so every nonzero degree-\(3m\) fiber is integral. Arithmetic genus and delta invariants give normalization genera \(3m^2-3m+1\) and \(2m^2-3m+1\). The packaged checker passed exact characteristic-zero symbolic identities and separate finite-field spot checks; the latter do not replace the general proof.

value.rationale: This is the full parameter-discriminant and singularity classification of the minimal coordinate-invariant one-term smoothing of the classical Fermat–Ceva arrangement, across all \(m\ge2\). Exactly two nonzero fibers acquire \(m^2\) ordinary nodes and experience the same genus drop; this is a natural geometric degeneration of a well-studied arrangement, with motivation beyond a parameter exercise. Its critical values, branching and genus have independent geometric interpretations.
